personality: Fusion: 7 Dark-First Utility structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A premium, high-performance athletic ecosystem combining cinematic sports imagery with dark-first utility and subtle gold accents.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for cinematic feel; tight padding for dense metric rows. Never leave orphaned half-width cards.

do's: Use heavy tint (≥75% surface opacity) underneath glass for readability.
Apply to sticky headers, bottom tab bar, and hero cards.
Use over sports imagery for cinematic layering.
dont's: Do not apply to form fields or dense metric body content.
Do not use transparent glass over high-contrast images without a dark scrim.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Personalized feed with location-aware hero image and primary calls to action (Find Game, AI Coach).

states.loading: Dark skeleton loaders matching surfaceSecondary with subtle shimmer.
states.empty: Cinematic abstract sports texture with 'Ready to dominate?' prompt and primary CTA.
states.error: Centered warning icon with 'Connection lost' and a subtle gold Retry button.

screens.layout: Hero image stretches full bleed at the top with a heavy gradient-to-dark scrim. Primary CTA (Find a Game) is a solid gold pill below hero text. Content below is arranged in a multi-column grid for metrics, and full-width cards for AI Coach insights and upcoming sessions.

screens.name: Discover
screens.purpose: Rich card-based discovery of facilities, players, events, and coaches with location awareness.

states.empty: No events nearby. 'Adjust filters or expand radius' with a primary CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky top filter row with glass effect. Facility cards are full-width, utilizing high-quality sports photography with gradient scrims and bold condensed typography over images.

screens.name: Court Booking
screens.purpose: Seamless flow from facility selection to date, time slot, and booking confirmation.

states.empty: No slots available on this date. Prompt to pick another date.

screens.layout: A bottom-sheet driven flow for date/time selection. Uses horizontal scrolling for dates and a neat flex grid for time slots. Bottom-fixed sticky CTA 'Confirm Booking'.

screens.name: Match Engine & Play
screens.purpose: Find or create open games, featuring a % compatibility score overlay on player avatars.

states.empty: No open games match your skill level. 'Create a Game' prominent CTA.

screens.layout: Dense list items for available games. Each row features a tinted icon container, game details in Manrope, and a circular badge displaying % compatibility score using brandTertiary background and brandPrimary text.

screens.name: AI Coach
screens.purpose: Chat interface for personalized training plans and performance insights.

states.empty: Initial state: 'What should we focus on today? (Speed, Form, Strategy)'
states.error: AI Coach is currently analyzing offline. Try again soon.

screens.layout: Standard chat view but styled cinematically. User bubbles in surfaceTertiary, AI Coach bubbles in brandTertiary with gold text. Sticky input at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Marketplace
screens.purpose: Browse and buy premium sports equipment like paddles, shoes, and apparel.
screens.layout: 2-column grid utilizing flexWrap. Product images sit on surfaceSecondary background. Clean pricing in gold accent. Sticky 'View Cart' CTA over scrolling content.

marketplace_shoe.alt: White Nike Air Force shoe on dark background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark-first utility layout with luxury/glassmorphism aesthetics. Backgrounds should be deep obsidian (not pure black).
NO BLUE OR PURPLE ALLOWED ANYWHERE. Use the provided gold brand colors for all primary actions and indicators.
Utilize 'Barlow Condensed' for sports metrics, scores, compatibility %, and section headers. Use 'Manrope' for body text and descriptive labels.
Implement the 'gradient-to-dark scrim' for every hero image to guarantee contrast. Start transparent at 0%, 20% surfaceInverse at 50%, and >70% surfaceInverse at bottom.
Include sticky primary CTAs (e.g., 'Confirm Booking', 'Find a Game') placed at the bottom within a fixed glass/blur container.
Match Engine rows must display a distinct % compatibility score using a bold pill/badge (brandTertiary bg / brandPrimary text).
